title_en: Kwanjeong Educational Foundation 2027 New Undergraduate Scholarship Recommendations (Due 12 November)
summary: Interested undergraduate students who will enter their fifth semester in Spring 2027 with a cumulative GPA of 3.8/4.3 or higher may apply for the department's recommendation for the 2027 Kwanjeong Educational Foundation new undergraduate scholarship. Applicants must email the required documents to the department office by 17:00 on Thursday, 12 November 2026. Students who are recommended must later upload their documents when the Foundation sends its email notice for the online document submission (stage 2).
applies_to: Undergraduate students who will be entering their fifth semester in Spring 2027 and have a cumulative GPA of 3.8/4.3 or higher. Detailed eligibility is set out in the Foundation's selection plan (Attachment 2-1). Applying is optional and is for interested students only.

dates.what: Deadline to email application documents to the department office
Eligibility: applicants must be entering their fifth semester in this semester

conditions: Applicants must be entering their fifth semester in Spring 2027 and have a cumulative GPA of 3.8/4.3 or higher; further eligibility rules are in Attachment 2-1.
Each undergraduate department may recommend at most 2 students, and the College of Engineering plans to recommend at most 10 students.
If more than 10 students apply in the College of Engineering, recommendees will be selected by GPA on a 4.3 scale.
Ties will be broken by grades in this order: GPA percentile, then the previous semester's grades.

Students may choose between Type A and Type B for the scholarship amount and support period; the amounts and periods are not given in the notice text and are presumably in the attachments, which were not read.
Students recommended by the university must upload the required documents when the Foundation sends its email notice for online document submission (stage 2).
Students who pass the first-stage document review should check the schedule for the expert review (stage 2) and the interview (stage 3) in advance.
steps: Read the Foundation's 2027 selection plan (Attachment 2-1) carefully, including the detailed eligibility, Type A and Type B options and the review schedule.
Complete the Excel recommendation list (Attachment 3), 1 copy.
Complete the consent form for the collection, use and provision of personal information (Attachment from the Scholarship and Welfare Division, external foundations), 1 copy.
Prepare 1 copy of each document listed as mandatory for the first-stage online review in section 7 of Attachment 2-1.
Email all documents to the department office by 17:00 on Thursday, 12 November 2026 (the email address is in the original notice).
If you are recommended, upload the required documents when the Foundation emails you about online document submission (stage 2).
If you pass the first-stage document review, check the dates of the expert review (stage 2) and interview (stage 3) in advance.
translation:
Recommendation for 2027 Kwanjeong Educational Foundation New Undergraduate Scholarship Students (Deadline: Thursday, 12 November)

The Kwanjeong Educational Foundation is selecting new undergraduate scholarship students for 2027 as follows. Interested students are asked to apply.

A. Number of recommendations: Up to 2 students per undergraduate department. ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend up to 10 students.

B. Eligibility: Students who will enter their fifth semester in Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기) with a cumulative GPA of 3.8/4.3 or higher. ※ For detailed eligibility, refer to the scholarship selection plan [Attachment 2-1].

C. Scholarship amount and support period. ※ Students may choose either Type A or Type B. (The details are not given in the notice text; they appear to be in the attachments, which were not read.)

D. Application deadline and method: By 17:00 on Thursday, 12 November 2026, submit by email to the department office (the email address is in the original notice).

E. Documents to submit:
1. [Attachment 3] Excel recommendation list, 1 copy
2. [Attachment: Scholarship and Welfare Division – External Foundations] Consent form for the collection, use and provision of personal information, 1 copy
3. [Attachment 2-1] Section 7: documents required for the first-stage online review, 1 copy each
※ If more applications are received than the College of Engineering's recommendation quota (10 students), recommendees will be selected by GPA on a 4.3 scale. In the event of a tie, selection will be by grades in this order: GPA percentile, then the previous semester's grades.

F. Notes
1. You must check the Foundation's selection plan [Attachment 2-1].
2. Students recommended by the university must upload the required documents when the Foundation sends an email notice about online document submission (stage 2).
※ Students who pass the first-stage document review should check the schedule for the expert review (stage 2) and the interview (stage 3) in advance.

G. Contacts
The contacts for the Kwanjeong Educational Foundation and the College of Engineering are listed in the original notice.

Attachments (4) (not read):
2-1. 2027 Domestic University Scholarship Student Selection Plan (PDF)
2-2. Regulations on the Selection of Domestic University Scholarship Students and Payment of Scholarships (10th amendment) (PDF)
3. 2027 Kwanjeong Scholarship Recommendation List (Undergraduate) (Excel)
Consent form for the collection, use and provision of personal information (Scholarship and Welfare Division – External Foundations) (HWP)
